name: Ferrum
description: Sandbox/local modes, host access only through local_* tools, policy, approvals and audit

localRoot.description: Windows folder the local_* tools may touch, e.g. D:\Ferrum

localRootMount.description: Where localRoot is visible from the gateway (WSL), e.g. /mnt/d/Ferrum

idleMinutes.description: local mode falls back to sandbox after this many idle minutes

confirmSeconds.description: validity of the /mode local confirmation code
